preservedOriginalEight.title: Coffee together
preservedOriginalEight.description: Make time for a drink and a catch-up with people you know.
tips: Choose a place where everyone can sit together.
Agree a time that works for the group.

preservedOriginalEight.title: Painting
preservedOriginalEight.description: Paint a scene, an object or an abstract design together. Try different colours and let everyone take their own approach.
tips: Bring paints, brushes and something to paint on.
Look at painting styles for inspiration.

preservedOriginalEight.title: Get out with bikes
preservedOriginalEight.description: Get together for a bicycle ride and enjoy some time outside.
tips: Agree the route and meeting place in advance.
Choose a route everyone in the group is comfortable with.

preservedOriginalEight.title: Building a snowman
preservedOriginalEight.description: When there is enough snow, get together to build and decorate a snowman.
tips: Choose a suitable outdoor spot.
Bring warm clothes and simple decorations.

preservedOriginalEight.title: BBQ
preservedOriginalEight.description: Share a barbecue and spend time together over food.
tips: Agree who is bringing the food and equipment.
Check dietary preferences with your guests.

preservedOriginalEight.title: Wine tasting
preservedOriginalEight.description: Get together to compare wines and talk about what you notice.
tips: Choose a suitable place and agree what to bring.
Have water and alcohol-free options available.

preservedOriginalEight.title: Spa day
preservedOriginalEight.description: Set aside time to relax together at a spa.
tips: Choose the place together.
Check availability before confirming your plan.

preservedOriginalEight.title: Book Club
preservedOriginalEight.description: Meet to talk about a book you have chosen together.
tips: Agree the book before the meeting.
Bring a question or a favourite passage to discuss.

intendedAfterImage.title: Picnic in the park
intendedAfterImage.description: Bring a few simple things to share and make time for a relaxed picnic together.
tips: Choose a spot with seating or room for a blanket, and agree what everyone will bring.
Check food preferences and the weather, then leave the place as you found it.

intendedAfterImage.title: Walk and talk
intendedAfterImage.description: Take an easy walk with someone you know. Choose a comfortable pace and enjoy a little time to catch up.
tips: Agree a route and pace that suit everyone, including places to pause.
Choose a clear meeting point and check the weather before setting off.

intendedAfterImage.title: Board game night
intendedAfterImage.description: Gather around a game, learn the rules together and enjoy a friendly evening of play.
tips: Pick a game that suits the number of people and explain the rules before you start.
Make room for everyone around the table and keep the atmosphere relaxed.
